newsitem.title: USA: Mass., R.I. health care markets seen merging -- S&P.
newsitem.headline: Mass., R.I. health care markets seen merging -- S&P.

text.p: Health care providers in Massachusetts and Rhode Island are likely to become part of a regionalized system of hospitals, Standard & Poor's Corp said in Monday's edition of CreditWeek Municipal.
"It is more than likely that these two markets will eventually become a part of a much larger regional system," S&P said.
In a review of the Rhode Island market, S&P noted the announcement in April that Care New England in Rhode Island and CareGroup Hospital System in Massachusetts were in affiliation talks.

"Ultimately it will be those hospital systems with strong geographic coverage, low cost positions, and an integrated physician-managed care component that will be well-positioned to succeed in this changing market," S&P said.
